items.description:
Epsilon Engineering Services is an engineering company in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, that has operated since 1988 under the strapline Turning Technology into Applications. Its five service areas are aeronautical engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, composite technology and systems engineering, and its site presents products developed across each of these fields, including tape laying machines, fuze testers, geo-survey booms and crew cab extensions.

Among its listed work is the development of composite airframes and sub-systems for the Rooivalk Combat Support Helicopter, along with other unmanned aerial systems built up to and since 2018. The company describes its commitment as providing cutting-edge technology solutions and engineering expertise that creates continuous growth for its customers. It suits clients needing specialised mechanical, aeronautical, electrical or composite engineering work carried out by an established Centurion firm.

EQPlus Technologies is an ICT consulting and managed services provider, supplying businesses with managed IT support, talent acquisition and rapid-resourcing deployment, and accelerated management development programmes. Its ICT consulting work is aimed at helping client organisations fill skills gaps and keep systems running without carrying a full in-house IT team.

Founded in 1999, the privately held company has grown into a team of between 11 and 50 people, with offices in Gauteng and the Western Cape. It operates from Building E, Lyttletown Office Park, 260 Shelanti Road, The Hoewes, Centurion, serving corporate clients who need IT and resourcing support delivered through a single partner.

Equity Pharmaceuticals is a pharmaceutical company based in Irene, Centurion, that has been a market leader in unlicensed medicine supply in South Africa since 2009. It specialises in scheduled, registered medicines for gastroenterology, neurology, oncology, infectious diseases, chronic conditions and substance abuse, along with a hospital division.

Its Equity Section 21 division focuses on the import and supply of unlicensed medicines, managing access to around 450 products through Managed Access and Global Access Programs, with the top 150 unlicensed products kept in its warehouse for immediate patient assistance. The company leverages a network of global suppliers and wholesalers to meet urgent medical needs, and states a zero-tolerance policy on bribery and corruption. It suits healthcare providers and hospitals needing scheduled or unlicensed medicines sourced through a compliant, established supplier.

Ferro Eleganza is a structural steel company based in Samcor Park, Pretoria, and part of the Gino Narbonese group of companies, founded in 1985. With more than 20 years of experience in the structural steel industry, the company describes itself as a leader in various African countries in this field, and its site states it has been at the forefront of structural steel construction since its inception.

The company is affiliated with bodies including the Southern African Institute of Welding and the cidb, and takes part in skills development through merSETA, reflecting a focus on welding and fabrication standards alongside its construction work. It suits developers and contractors needing light to heavy structural steel fabrication for commercial, architectural or industrial projects from an established Pretoria manufacturer.

items.description:
Fishaways Eldoraigne is a seafood takeaway and sit-down restaurant serving the chain's signature hake and chips, grilled fish, seafood platters and hot pots, alongside sushi, plant-based options and combo meals designed for sharing. The menu covers everything from a quick fish-and-chips lunch to a full seafood spread for a group, with collection, delivery and dine-in all available.

The restaurant trades from Shop 57 in Eldoraigne Village Shopping Centre, 1033 Saxby Avenue, Eldoraigne, Centurion, and is open seven days a week from 09:00 to 21:00. It suits anyone after a casual seafood meal, whether eating in, ordering for collection, or having it delivered.

FlowCentric is a software company based in Monument Park, Pretoria, founded in 2000, that develops FlowCentric Processware, a workflow automation and operational intelligence platform. Rather than replacing a client's core systems, the platform extends and governs the work between existing systems, coordinating the people, information, rules and decisions that cross them.

Its services combine process expertise, professional services and the Processware platform itself, with supporting technologies including BusinessOptix, TOKN and RealSign. The company's platform is used across complex operational environments including aviation, mining, manufacturing, financial services, private security and public-sector operations. It suits medium and large organisations that want better operational control, system integration and accountable decision-making without replacing the systems they already run.

Friday Club Network is a branch of Friday Club, a business networking organisation founded 35 years ago by Allan Hammond with the mission of connecting like-minded business people. Entrepreneurs and professionals in the network gather weekly for a Friday morning breakfast meeting to network and promote their businesses to a diversified group of people.

Beyond the weekly breakfasts, the club offers workshops on marketing, sales and effective networking, access to top industry leaders and high-level speakers, and exclusive member-only events and training. The organisation describes itself as South Africa's premier business networking club, with branches across the country. This Centurion branch meets from Irene, and it suits business owners and professionals who want a regular, structured way to build referral networks and learn from other members.

Friendly Butcher is a butchery at The Quiney Shopping Centre in Die Hoewes, Centurion, stocking fresh meat and braai essentials for everyday cooking and weekend fires. Customers single out the beef and mince for quality, along with the in-house sausage and boerewors and the biltong on offer, and regularly order lamb cut and prepared specifically for spit-braai occasions.

Independent customer feedback consistently points to good meat quality and attentive service as the shop's strengths, built on repeat custom rather than marketing. The butchery trades from Gerhard Street in Centurion and is well suited to households stocking up for a family braai or a spit.

items.description:
Fullzone Branding is part of the Fullzone Group, a group of companies formed in 2012 that started with Fullzone printing. It specialises in indoor and outdoor exposure products, including gazebos, gazebo walls and extras, kiosks, sharkfin and telescopic banners, curve and fountain banners, A-frames, and umbrellas, parasols and their extras.

The company says it has worked for years perfecting its sublimation programme, sourcing reliable hardware systems and the most durable materials it could find, and it combines competitive pricing with quick turnaround times. It is based on Uitspan Road in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, and it suits businesses that need branded displays and signage ready in time for an event, product launch or advertising campaign.

Galaxy Gold And Diamond Buyers is a local gold and diamond buying service in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, where customers can walk in and get paid for their gold on the spot. Its staff test and weigh items in front of the customer, and the business says it works directly with the refinery to cut out the middle man, which it uses to offer a higher price than jewellery stores or pawn shops.

What it buys covers yellow, white and rose gold, wedding bands and engagement rings, chains, pendants and earrings, dental gold, gold coins, silver and platinum jewellery, bracelets, bangles, and broken or damaged pieces, along with watches; it does not buy the R5 Mandela coin. It suits anyone in Centurion who wants a fast, transparent valuation and same-day payment for gold, diamonds or jewellery they no longer want.

GALXBOY Pretoria East is a branch of GALXBOY, a South African design and apparel brand that describes itself under the strapline Smart. African. Ambitious. It trades from Co.Space Entrepreneur Village in Willow Park Manor and online, with free shipping anywhere in South Africa. Its range covers T-shirts, shorts, hoodies and sweaters, pants, jackets, bowling shirts and shorts, footwear including sneakers and sandals, caps and bags.

Products include the GXB Island, Aqua and Web Slide sandals, canvas and embossed caps, and graphic T-shirt ranges such as the Scorpion Kings and Bafana Bafana collections. The brand positions itself as Made To Last, built around South African streetwear and sport-linked designs. It suits customers in Pretoria East looking for locally designed streetwear, footwear and accessories.

Genband Africa is a South African, Level 1 B-BBEE information technology and telecommunications company with African roots, launched in 2014 and based in Kosmosdal, Pretoria. The company is 40% female-owned and 60% youth-owned, and it is a Cisco Select Partner under the Cisco SMME Programme. Its services include engineering and professional services covering end-to-end technology and network solutions, fibre infrastructure build, and last-mile fibre planning for homes and businesses.

The company's CEO brings 30 years of experience in the ICT sector, including more than 25 years in international product sales, strategic account management and project management, having previously served as Client Director at Cisco South Africa overseeing the Telkom account. It suits businesses and service providers in need of Cisco networking expertise, fibre infrastructure or managed telecommunications services from a locally rooted, empowered partner.

GERNIC PRODUCTS CC is a family-owned manufacturer of paint rollers, paint brushes, household brushes, brooms, mops, squeegees and dustpans, alongside a range of gardening products. The catalogue runs from industrial brooms and squeegees and builders' brushes through to paint rollers, roller handles, paint trays and scrapers, and general household cleaning products, built up since the company was established in 1987.

Manufacturing from 177 Lever Road in Rosslyn, Pretoria, the business describes itself as a one-stop supplier for home and garden products, serving both the trade and the wholesale market from a single Pretoria base. It suits retailers and bulk buyers looking for an established local source for cleaning and painting essentials.

Global Media Group is a Pretoria-based design and printing company offering graphic design, digital printing and large-format printing alongside lithographic and web printing services. Its work covers printed marketing materials such as leaflets, newsletters and posters, as well as bespoke graphic design and branding projects, giving clients a single provider for both the creative design work and the physical printing it ends up as.

With more than 18 years of experience in the advertising and printing industry, the company operates from 402 Bart Joubert Street in Erasmia, Pretoria. It suits businesses that need design and print handled together, from a single concept through to the finished printed piece, rather than briefing a design studio and a printer separately.

Goddess Café Waterkloof is a branch of Goddess Café, which describes itself as South Africa's pinkest café, with six pink-themed locations across Pretoria and Johannesburg. The Waterkloof branch trades from Shop 6 at Waterkloof Corner Shopping Centre and serves all-day breakfasts, long lunches, fancy high teas and cake, with a menu that includes plenty of vegetarian options.

The café has an adjoining private venue used for parties, baby showers, kitchen teas and other celebrations, supported by dedicated function planners who handle bookings from first enquiry to final candle, with décor available in a customer's chosen colours and optional themed party packs. The chain holds a 4.2 TripAdvisor rating and says 90% of guests recommend it. Trading hours at this branch are Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm, Saturday from 8am to 5pm and Sunday from 8am to 3pm, and it suits groups wanting a relaxed brunch or a planned celebration in Waterkloof.

GREEN Solar Academy Pretoria is a solar PV training venue at Unit 4, Eco Square on Witch-Hazel Avenue in Highveld, Centurion. Its 2026 course list runs from entry points such as Solar 101 and the Principles of PV Systems eLearning course through to the PV Off-Grid Technician eLearning course, PV Mounter training worth 2 CPD points, Working at Heights, and the SuperSolarSchool PV GreenCard programme, with Design and Advanced Commercial PV Design worth 3 CPD points and a course on financing PV systems also offered.

The site helps prospective students work out which course to take based on their starting point, and it lists accreditation and certification details alongside its course calendar. Free parking is available at the venue, making it straightforward for attendees to find and use. It suits electrical professionals and newcomers in the Centurion area who want formal, accredited training in solar photovoltaic installation and design.

items.description:
GT Consulting Engineers (Pty) Ltd is a mechanical engineering consultancy specialising in HVAC and building-services design, covering air-conditioning and ventilation systems, air extraction, and precision cooling for server rooms and data centres. The practice also designs systems for hospital operating theatres and restaurant kitchen extraction, carries out indoor-air-quality assessments, and runs HVAC equipment condition surveys and airflow measurements for existing buildings.

Founded in 2015, its engineers are registered with the Engineering Council of South Africa, and recent project work includes a hybrid VRF air-handling system installed at a manufacturing facility. The practice is based at 17 Safraan Avenue, Pretoria, and serves commercial, industrial, healthcare and hospitality clients needing HVAC systems designed, assessed or upgraded.

Guesthouse at Bailey's offers self-catering guest accommodation in air-conditioned rooms, each with its own kitchen, for travellers wanting more space and independence than a standard hotel room. The property has a swimming pool, free Wi-Fi and free parking for guests, along with on-site dining and a small fitness centre, and it welcomes guests travelling with pets.

Located at 411 Julius Street in Bailey's Muckleneuk, Pretoria, the guesthouse is close to Hatfield, Loftus Versfeld Stadium and Brooklyn Mall, making it a convenient base for visitors attending events or needing easy access to those areas. It suits business travellers, event-goers and anyone wanting self-catering comfort with hotel-style extras.

Hirsch's Centurion is a branch of the Hirsch's home appliance, electronics and home-technology chain, stocking major kitchen and laundry appliances, TVs, audio and small electronics for the home. The store offers both delivery and in-store collection, and is an official stockist of AEG appliances, giving shoppers access to that brand's range alongside the wider Hirsch's offering.

The branch trades from Shop 28, Gateway Plaza, on Old Johannesburg Road in Centurion, part of a family-run chain that has grown into one of South Africa's largest privately owned appliance retailers. It suits households furnishing a kitchen or laundry, or anyone comparing appliance brands under one roof, whether buying in-store or arranging delivery.

ICE Holdings is a South African diversified solutions group established in 2016 and based in Clubview, Centurion, bringing together four core divisions under one group. ICE One covers comprehensive water solutions, sustainable resources and critical infrastructure management, while ICE Technology handles IT infrastructure, hardware sales, custom software development and VoIP communications.

ICE Business provides corporate consulting and specialised business services, and ICE Security covers physical and digital security. The group describes its approach as combining expertise, trusted partnerships and practical innovation to solve real operational challenges, with solutions built around each client's requirements. It suits businesses that want water, technology, consulting or security needs handled by divisions within one connected group, based at Porta Group House on Lyttelton Road in Clubview.

ICEWORX Printing & Graphix is a large-format printing company based in Kilner Park, Pretoria, with easy access to the N1 freeway that lets it service clients as far afield as Mpumalanga and Limpopo, as well as the Pretoria and Johannesburg area. Its products include vehicle branding using premium cast and outdoor vinyls with protective overlaminate films, suitable for anything from a small car to a fleet of trucks, along with outdoor PVC banners printed on its own UV printer.

The company underwent an ownership and management change in 2022, bringing in four working directors with a combined 80 years of experience in the printing industry. It runs a fleet of state-of-the-art printing machinery on site, covering jobs from quick-turnaround stickers to outdoor UV banners up to three metres wide. It suits businesses in and around Pretoria that need vehicle branding, banners or large-format signage produced locally.

IEDM is a full-service digital marketing agency offering Google Ads and PPC campaign management, social media marketing and website development for businesses wanting a stronger online presence. As a Google Premier Partner, the agency builds data-driven campaigns aimed at increasing visibility, generating leads and converting visitors into sales, rather than running generic advertising for its own sake.

The agency operates from Karoo Dorp, Unit 1, 141 Lynnwood Road, in The Willows, Pretoria, and is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm. It suits businesses looking for one partner to handle paid advertising, social platforms and the website itself, rather than juggling separate suppliers for each.

Ijaba Security Services provides integrated security and risk-management solutions, including client-service management, criminal-record checks, polygraph testing and real-time monitoring of security patrols on the ground. Alongside its core security offering, the company runs skills-development and SASSETA-accredited training programmes, giving clients access to vetted, trained personnel rather than a security service alone.

Established in 2011 and based in Centurion, the company operates from Crystal Park, Block H, 249 Basden Avenue, Die Hoewes, serving both commercial and residential clients. It suits businesses and residential complexes that need ongoing risk management and patrol oversight handled by a single, accredited provider, rather than security and training sourced from separate companies.

Iniek Boutique is a bridal boutique and laser-cutting and printing studio based in Pretoria East, at Grootfontein Country Estate. Its bridal side offers ready-to-wear and made-to-order wedding gowns designed for elegance, comfort and timeless beauty, with fittings available by appointment only, as the boutique operates from an exclusive home-based setting. Its Iniek Endless Crafting side produces custom laser-cut and printed décor, including invitations, welcome signs, cake toppers, custom gifts, home décor, stationery, corporate items and a baby range.

The name Iniek means unique, reflecting the studio's focus on personalised pieces for weddings, events and everyday celebrations. The boutique says it focuses on fine detail and craftsmanship so that brides can find a dress that feels right without compromising on quality or price, in a calm, personal setting. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm, and it suits brides and hosts in Pretoria East who want bridal wear and custom wedding décor from one studio.

Insly Host is a South African web hosting company based in Pretoria Central, offering web hosting from R39 a month on NVMe SSD servers. Its plans include shared, business, VPS, reseller, WordPress and dedicated hosting, each with free SSL and daily backups, alongside domain registration and transfer for .co.za, .org.za, .web.za and .com domains, business email, website design, e-commerce web design and website maintenance.

The company says it keeps more than 2,000 South African websites online, with a 99.9% uptime guarantee and 24/7 support from a team in the same time zone as its customers. Domains, hosting, email and websites are managed under a single login, which it presents as a simpler way to get a business online. It suits South African businesses and individuals who want local hosting support alongside their domain and website needs.

Interface Solutions is a business management supply chain consulting firm established in 2010 and based in Midstream Estate. It works with international and multinational companies, listed companies, and small to medium enterprises, focusing on the total cost of ownership of a client's supply chain to identify where substantial costs can be saved. Its services cover international supply chain services, global clearing and forwarding, project and turnkey consulting, warehousing and distribution, local and cross-border trucking, and customs refunds and drawbacks.

The firm's consultation is offered at zero fee and with no obligation, and it says clients do not need to change their current service providers to benefit from its recommendations. Interface Solutions works on a gainshare model, charging based on the actual savings it achieves for a client, through a transparent and collaborative process carried out by qualified individuals. It suits organisations wanting an independent review of their logistics and distribution costs without taking on new overheads.

International Runners Service, also known as IRS, is a logistics and freight business based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, that describes itself as a logistics specialist to Zimbabwe. It runs express delivery of small and large cargo, with a dedicated consolidation service to Zimbabwe twice a week, typically delivering in 5 to 10 days from the time a shipment is manifested, using a fleet that ranges from 1-ton open and closed vehicles up to 15-ton trucks.

The company says its consistent delivery schedule helps client companies avoid holding large stock levels, improving their cash flow, and it focuses only on shipments it can commit to rather than taking on every load available. Its value-added services include close oversight of each shipment to minimise errors, guidance on VAT requirements and daily updates to customers. It suits businesses that need reliable, scheduled freight into the Southern African region, particularly Zimbabwe.

INTO SOLAR ENERGY is a solar distributor, online retailer and installer supplying lithium batteries, solar pumps, solar floodlights and inverters, with installation and fix-and-supply services for homes and businesses switching to solar. Beyond outright sales, the company also offers solar subscriptions and solar rental, giving customers a way to access solar power without the full upfront cost of a system.

Registered as IN TO SOLAR ENERGY (Pty) Ltd, the business operates from Unit 5A, 15 Akwamaryn Street in Klerksoord, Akasia, Pretoria, and is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays until 2pm. It suits households and small businesses wanting solar equipment supplied, installed and financed through one local provider.

Invoke Solutions is an IT solutions provider serving the Bryntirion and Garsfontein area of Pretoria, describing itself under the strapline Grow. Design. Thrive. Its service areas include application development and integration, business information systems, information management, cyber security, ICT resource capacitation and hardware and support, delivered as part of turnkey ICT consulting.

The company says it helps organisations across industries unleash the power of information to gain valuable insights, and it lists IBM and AWS among its technology partners. It also runs events for clients, including sessions on implementing electronic document and records management systems and cybersecurity best practice workshops. It suits organisations in Pretoria that want application development, information systems or cyber security handled by a single ICT partner with established technology partnerships.

iRender is South Africa's certified SketchUp Gold Reseller, based in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion, with more than 25 years of expertise and 18 years as a SketchUp reseller. It sells SketchUp Go, Pro and Studio licences along with the SketchUp ADV Workflow and SketchUp Scan Pro, offering ZAR invoicing and dedicated local support so customers avoid dealing in foreign currency.

The company has deployed more than 1,400 licences and serves architects, interior designers, landscape architects and construction professionals across South Africa, alongside educational licensing for students and educators. Pricing runs on annual subscriptions paid by EFT in rands or by credit card, with no monthly payment plan available. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and it suits design and construction professionals who need SketchUp licensing and support from a long-established local reseller.

Izinso Dialysis Services Eersterust is a branch of Izinso Dialysis Services, trading from Shop 19 and 20 at Eersterust Mall. The network describes its mission as providing quality, affordable dialysis services to Southern African communities, supporting kidney disease sufferers after diagnosis and helping improve their quality of life once dialysis therapy begins. It also provides services to hospitals, other patients, doctors and medical funders.

Beyond the Eersterust branch, the network operates units in Ga-Rankuwa, Hammanskraal, Kempton Park, Mahikeng, Pretoria West, Soshanguve, Soweto and Eswatini, giving it a wide footprint across the region. It suits dialysis patients and referring doctors in the Eersterust area who need accessible, ongoing renal care close to home.

Jacage Supplies is an industrial supplier in Moregloed, Pretoria, that has served the construction, manufacturing and mining industries since 2004. Its sales advisors offer expert advice to help customers choose the right industrial product for their application, and the company describes itself as a reliable industrial supplier offering quality, cost-effective products.

Among its services are welding machine repairs, with expert technicians handling 3-phase machine repairs on site and single-phase machines serviced in-house to get equipment back into the workshop or production line. The company also offers 30-day account applications for approved account holders, with credit applications handled through appointed third-party approval agencies. It is open Monday to Thursday from 7:30am to 4:30pm and Friday from 7:30am to 2pm, and it suits construction, engineering, mining and municipal customers who need industrial supplies or welding equipment repaired.

JAK Transport is a Centurion-based transport company and subsidiary of Mopane Holdings Ltd, founded in 2014. Its staff bring more than 15 years of experience in car rental, van rental and flight booking services, built on a background in the tourism industry alongside service delivery and IT networking. The company specialises in both passenger and goods transport, with car rental, truck hire, shuttle services and chauffeur drive among its offerings.

It also arranges sightseeing tours, including Soweto tours, city tours, Sun City and game drives, and provides bus hire for school, church or corporate events, along with domestic, regional and international flight bookings. The company currently offers bakkie hire from R350 for a 1.5-tonne van, with a 10% discount for returning customers. It suits individuals and businesses in Centurion needing vehicle hire, group transport or flight bookings from one provider.

Jasmine Palace is a restaurant trading from Shop 3 at Constantia Park Shopping Centre, on the corner of Duvernoy and Niesewand Street. Online directory listings for the restaurant give it a rating above 4 stars from more than 100 reviews, and list it under the restaurant trade with meal takeaway as part of its offering.

The restaurant is open Monday, and Wednesday through Sunday, from 11:30am to 9:30pm, and closed on Tuesdays, so diners have six days a week to visit for a sit-down meal or a takeaway order. It suits residents of Constantia Park and the surrounding area looking for a nearby restaurant with regular evening and lunchtime hours.

Johannesburg Artificial Grass Installers is an artificial grass supply and installation business based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, with professional installers who have more than 10 years of experience in the field. The company supplies and installs artificial grass across South Africa, covering residential lawns, playgrounds and soccer fields, along with landscaping, commercial, garden and patio turf.

Its products are described as eco-friendly and durable, designed to stay versatile, cleaner and greener all year round whether laid indoors or outdoors, while cutting down the time and money spent on lawn upkeep. The company offers a free quote for new installations and says it prides itself on professional service and minimising maintenance for its clients. It suits homeowners, schools, sports clubs and businesses across South Africa who want a long-lasting lawn without the usual watering and mowing.

Jovien Communications is a business technology company based in Monavoni, Centurion, established in 2013 and operating as a Level 1 B-BBEE business with nationwide delivery. It positions itself as one partner for business technology, covering managed IT, cybersecurity, connectivity, telephony, security and intelligent automation, from structured cabling in the ceiling through to the cloud, firewall, phones and cameras.

The company works through authorised technology partner relationships across the brands it supplies, so that products are genuine, correctly specified and supported as one accountable environment rather than separate vendor relationships. Its process runs through four stages: understanding a client's people, sites, systems, risks and budget; designing one joined-up solution with clear responsibility; delivering installation, configuration and testing; and ongoing support that resolves issues and improves the environment. It suits South African businesses that want one accountable team managing their IT, telephony and security instead of juggling multiple suppliers.

KFC Atteridgeville Atlyn Centre is a branch of the KFC fried-chicken chain, trading from Atteridgeville Plaza Shopping Centre on the corner of Nkhoza and Phudufufu Streets in Atteridgeville. Like other KFC branches, it serves the chain's crispy fried chicken, chicken buckets and sides, and this branch supports dine-in, collection and delivery, giving customers the choice between eating in, taking food away, or having an order delivered.

The branch trades into the evening, staying open until 9pm, which makes it a convenient option for an evening meal as well as lunch and takeaway orders during the day. It suits anyone in Atteridgeville after a quick, familiar meal, whether dining in at the centre, collecting an order on the way past, or arranging delivery to home or work.

Kratom Bliss South Africa is an online retailer based in Celtisdal, Centurion, selling lab-tested kratom in capsule and powder form. Its range is organised by vein and strain, covering white, green, red and gold kratom, with named strains including Super Green, Maeng Da and Red Borneo, and products are also grouped by effect, such as pain relief, energy, relaxation, mood enhancement, sleep aid, focus, anxiety and depression support.

The company says it promotes responsible and educated use, stating its products are not for habitual use, are not intended for anyone under 18 or who is pregnant or breastfeeding, and should not be used by people with medical conditions or on prescription medication without consulting a doctor first. It describes its products as natural supplements rather than pharmaceutical substitutes, and offers fast delivery across South Africa. It suits adult customers in South Africa looking for a specific, lab-tested kratom strain delivered to their door.

Kritzinger Ellish (Pretoria Branch) is a commercial property law firm that has advised landlords and managing agents since 2010, with offices in Pretoria and Durban serving clients across South Africa. The Pretoria branch is based in the Sorrento Building at Delmondo Office Park on Garsfontein Road in Ashlea Gardens.

Its three areas of expertise are rental recovery, where it pursues strategic solutions for owners of retail and commercial properties to maintain consistent cash flow and minimise financial disruption; eviction proceedings, handling specialised strategies for commercial and industrial properties through complex legal frameworks; and commercial contracts, drafting and negotiating agreements that protect corporate clients. It suits retail, commercial and industrial property owners and managing agents who need a specialist firm for rental-arrears recovery, evictions or lease and contract disputes.

Kruger House Museum in Pretoria Central is the preserved former home of Paul Kruger, State President of the old South African Republic, who lived there between 1883 and 1901 before leaving for exile in Europe during the Second Boer War. The Victorian-style house stands just a few blocks from Church Square, where his bronze statue faces the Palace of Justice.

The home has been refurbished to reflect the period when Kruger and his second wife, Gezina Kruger, lived there, and its exhibits include personal items such as a knife he used after a shooting incident and a pair of lions given to him by mining magnate Barney Barnato as a birthday present in 1896. The house was notably built using milk rather than water to mix the cement, was among the first in the city to use electricity, and had one of Pretoria's first telephones installed in 1891. It suits visitors interested in South African history who want to see where a key figure of the Boer War era actually lived.

L&B Consulting Engineering - Gauteng is the Pretoria office of L&B Engineering, a structural and civil engineering consultancy with a B-BBEE Level 4 contributor status, based at Val-de-Grace alongside a Western Cape office in Wellington. Its structural engineering services include reinforced concrete design and detailing, structural steel design, rational foundation design, brick and timber structures, NHBRC enrolments and late enrolments, structural inspections, site supervision and peer review.

The firm says it is committed to providing innovative, cost-effective, sustainable and versatile structural engineering solutions, tailoring each one to suit the individual project while aiming for a high level of excellence regardless of project size. It suits developers, builders and homeowners in Gauteng who need structural or civil engineering sign-off, from foundation design through to site inspections, on residential, commercial or industrial projects.

Lancea Konsult is a SYSPRO Elite Solutions Partner based in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, delivering tailored ERP implementation, integration and support across manufacturing, supply chain and logistics. The company describes itself as a family of industrial engineers, systems consultants and software developers committed to transforming how these businesses run on SYSPRO, aligning technology with each client's business strategy.

Its services address common challenges such as optimising supply chains through its Tempo offering, improving manufacturing operations through SYSPRO MOM by optimising production schedules, reducing downtime and enabling real-time performance monitoring, and connecting different business systems into one cohesive operating picture through its ERP systems work. It also builds solutions for unique processes that do not fit a standard ERP system. It suits manufacturing, supply chain and logistics businesses that run SYSPRO and need an implementation partner that understands their shop floor as well as their systems.

Landje is an event and wedding venue on a family-run smallholding in Shere, nestled in the heart of Pretoria East between Silver Lakes and Lombardy Estates. The property is surrounded by nature and offers farm-to-fork feasts along with ample space for families to enjoy themselves away from the busyness of the city, which the venue presents as the setting for a couple's special day.

Its facilities are named Die Stalle, Die Stoor, Die Tennisbaan and Die Laning, giving hosts a choice of spaces across the smallholding for venue hire, weddings and events, and the business also runs a mobile coffee bar and sells tables and merchandise. The venue encourages visitors to get in touch or see the property in person before booking. It suits couples and event organisers in Pretoria East who want a natural, farm-style setting rather than a conventional function venue.

Lieu Truck and Car Spares is a spares supplier based on the corner of the R573 and Maroela Weg in Kameeldrift East, trading since 1986. The business supplies a comprehensive range of automotive parts for drill rigs, trucks, heavy-duty vehicles and passenger cars, sourced from trusted brands including Donaldson, GUD, Bosch and Shell to ensure consistent quality.

Its team offers expert consultation to help customers select the right part for their vehicle, and where a product is not in stock, the business can source it quickly through special orders. The company says it keeps competitive pricing across its range and gives customers in-store support backed by product knowledge. It suits truck and car owners in the Kameeldrift area who need a specific part sourced at a fair price, with help choosing the right one.

LM Mundalamo Incorporated Attorneys is a small, 100% black-owned law firm in Booysens, Pretoria West, established and incorporated in 2009. The firm says its main objective is breaking barriers, empowering communities, and embracing the values of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, with a particular focus on the rights to dignity, equality and access to justice for the most vulnerable members of the community.

The firm is registered with the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission and with the Legal Practice Council, formerly the Law Society, and it has held valid Fidelity Fund Certificates every year since its founding. It describes itself as striving to maintain the highest ethical standards in its dealings with clients, the judiciary, fellow practitioners and regulatory bodies. It suits individuals in Pretoria West, particularly those from vulnerable communities, who need accessible and ethically grounded legal representation.
